title: Chapter 263 Three Hundred Thousand Years
content:
Chapter 263 Three Hundred Thousand Years

At this moment, the two of them were shocked and their hearts were already beating in their throats.

If Lu Xue’s father misunderstood this, who can save himself?

Seeing the two of them panicked, Lu Daosheng laughed and waved his hand and said, "I'll just say it casually, look, it scares you two."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and the others breathed a lot of relief, and their whole bodies were almost exhausted.

You joked that almost made me go to heaven on the spot.

"Okay, I won't make trouble with you."

Lu Daosheng's expression suddenly became solemn.

Looking at Xiao Luo and the others, he spoke, "The fairy world is very weak now, very weak, so fresh blood is urgently needed."

"If you rely solely on the former group of strong men, you will be afraid that the fairy world will be in danger."

Hearing this, Xiao Luo and the others were slightly stunned and immediately understood what Lu Daosheng meant.

The two looked at each other, then said firmly: "Master Lord, I am willing to follow Sister Xue and help each other!"

Although they are weak, they must express their opinions in front of Lu Daosheng at this moment.

At the same time, this is also an opportunity for them.

Lu Daosheng looked at the two of them for a long time and said slowly, "Remember what you said today."

Buzz —

Two bright golden lights suddenly appeared in front of Lu Daosheng.

The hot light immediately illuminated the entire square.

"This is?!"

Xiao Luo and the others looked at the light ball in front of them with shock, and at this moment they felt their blood radiating.

"go."

Lu Daosheng spoke gently, and two balls of golden light immediately penetrated into Xiao Luo and Qin Feng.

The next moment, the two of them opened their eyes wide and they hurriedly sat cross-legged on the ground.

At the same time, a strong aura continued to overflow from the two of them.

When Lu Xue, who was standing beside him, saw this scene, he quickly looked at Lu Daosheng, his clear big eyes flashing.

Recognizing Lu Xue's hot gaze, Lu Daosheng shook his head and smiled.

"Xiaoxue, your talented father is really full of you. The rest can only be mined by yourself."

Hearing this, Lu Xue scratched her head awkwardly, "Haha, is that right?"

If you think about it carefully, it seems to be the same.

When I practiced myself, I didn’t even have a bottleneck.

It seems that I should practice seriously for a while.

After a while, Xiao Luo and the others finally slowly opened their eyes and then exhaled a heavy breath of turbid air.

At this moment, the two of them felt refreshed and full of energy.

As for the real change, it can only be seen when the two of them are in the future.

"Xiao Luo, thank you City Lord Lu!"

Xiao Luo knelt on one knee directly, looking extremely respectful.

Qin Feng stood up and also knelt on one knee.

"Qin Feng, thank you, Lord City!"

Lu Daosheng waved his hand and a force immediately pulled the two of them up.

"Okay, the next path is up to you."

"It will never disappoint you!"

"By the way, dad, can I ask you alone?"

At this time, Lu Xue suddenly said.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng was slightly stunned, "I want someone? Who?"

Lu Xue pointed to a corner of the square.

Shi Liantian and Yuanyuan were standing there.

"Can Yuanyuan be with me?"

Shi Liantian was also slightly stunned and looked sideways at Yuanyuan behind him.

"Girl, Miss Lu Xue has already spoken. Are you willing to be with Miss Lu Xue?"

Yuanyuan did not hesitate at all.

"Master, my disciple is willing."

Seeing that neither of the master nor the disciple opposed it, Lu Daosheng did not refuse.

Immediately, another one was added to the team of Lu Xue and the three.

"Thank you dad!"

Lu Daosheng smiled and then poked out his right hand.

A blue dragon egg appeared in his hand, and the lines on it were flowing, looking very mysterious.

"This is?"

Lu Xue looked at the dragon egg in Lu Daosheng's hand in confusion.

This won't be,

Lu Daosheng nodded, "Ao Qing."

"Ah? Why did Xiaoqing return to the furnace and rebuild it?"

"Haha, when he comes out, the improvement will be great."

Hearing this, Lu Xue didn't say anything else.

Finally, we are going to part.

Lu Xue hesitated for a moment, and finally stepped forward and hugged Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun tightly.

The family of three hugged each other tightly, all speechless.

Everything that should be said has been said.

On the side, Xiao Luo and Qin Feng were a little embarrassed.

After a moment, the three separated.

"Dad, mom, my daughter is gone, take care of you."

......

Lu Xue left, holding a dragon egg in her arms, Xiao Luo, Qin Feng and Yuanyuan followed behind her and slowly stepped out of the deserted city.

At the entrance of the city.

Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun looked at the backs of Lu Xue and the other four left, and were immediately filled with emotion.

"People always have to grow up."

Yan Lingyun nodded slightly, "Our daughter will not lose to anyone."

After watching for a long time, Lu Daosheng sighed.

"That's it."

Immediately, Lu Daosheng waved his hand.

An invisible force immediately enveloped the entire deserted city.

Buzz —

I saw that the deserted city began to shrink rapidly. After a moment, a city that was only the size of a palm fell steadily in Lu Daosheng's hands.

Lu Daosheng and Yan Lingyun looked at each other.

"Let's go."

"good."

Immediately, the two soared into the sky and entered the sky.

The endless void turbulence rushed towards the two of them, trying to block their way.

But they were ignored by both of them.

I don’t know how long it took, in a vast galaxy.

The figures of Lu Daosheng and the others appeared here.

Further forward, there is a gray void area.

"Is it here?"

Yan Lingyun asked.

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng nodded, "Next, I will guard here for 300,000 years."

Yan Lingyun looked into the void in the distance, "I'll be with you."

Hearing this, Lu Daosheng smiled and looked down at the deserted city in his hand.

In the deserted city.

The huge change did not affect the slightest part of the deserted city.

The only thing that is a bit noticeable is that the sky has changed its color.

"It's time for the deserted city to settle down."

Lu Daosheng murmured to himself, then put pressure on his palms.

Buzz —

Suddenly, endless power of the law continued to surge into the deserted city.

The entire deserted city suddenly rose.

Layer after layer of seals were reinforced around the deserted city.

At this time, in the deserted city.

Everyone felt that the space around them suddenly became extremely powerful, and at the same time, a steady stream of energy poured out from the earth and sky of the deserted city.

The entire deserted city is even better than before.

There is no more blessing in the world that can compare to the deserted city.

Just as everyone was surprised, Lu Daosheng's voice sounded from the void of the deserted city.

"The next three hundred thousand years, the deserted city will escape the world."

It was like the sound of the great way kept echoing in everyone's ears.

Three hundred thousand years? !

Everyone was shocked, but they quickly reacted.

The city lord said this, it should be that a war will come in 300,000 years later.

Some people are excited.

But some militants were a little depressed.

In the deepest part of the world in the deserted city, looking at the vast Lu family army ahead, with a bitter face.

"It's going to be held in for another 300,000 years."
